english.note: Use 建議 as the everyday all-purpose verb when explicitly recommending a course of action or option.
This is the all-purpose choice for giving someone advice or recommending what to do.
Use this as the all-purpose verb for advising or suggesting that someone do something.

examples.english: I suggest you take the MTR there.

examples.english: I advise you to book your flight early.
